sn44.4:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā ca Sāriputto āyasmā ca MahāKoṭṭhiko Bārāṇasiyaṃ viharantipe IsipataneMigadāye|| || 2-7
sn44.4:1.3: Ko nu kho āvuso hetu ko paccayo yenetam avyākatam Bhagavatā ti || || 8
sn44.4:1.4: Rūpaṃ kho āvuso ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ || rūpasamudayam ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ || rūpanirodham ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ || rūpanirodhagāminim paṭipadam ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ || Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa hoti ||
sn44.4:1.5: Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa hoti ||
sn44.4:1.6: Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa hoti ||
sn44.4:1.7: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa hoti || || 9-11
sn44.4:1.11: Viññāṇaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtam || viññāṇasamudayam ajanato apassato yathābhūtaṃ || viññāṇanirodham ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ || viññāṇanirodhayāminim paṭipadam ajānato apassato yathābhūtam Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa hoti ||
sn44.4:1.12: Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa hoti ||
sn44.4:1.13: Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā pissa hoti ||
sn44.4:1.14: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa hoti || || 13
sn44.4:2.1: Rūpaṃ ca kho āvuso jānato passato yathābhūtam || rūpasamudayaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ || rūpanirodhaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ || rūpanirodhagāminim paṭipadaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ Hoti tathāgato param
sn44.4:2.6: Viññāṇaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ || viññāṇa samudayaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ || viññāṇanirodhaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ || viññāṇanirodhagāminim paṭipadaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtam Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa na hoti ||
sn44.4:2.7: Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa na hoti ||
sn44.4:2.9: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa na hoti || || 18
sn44.4:2.10: Ayaṃ kho āvuso hetu ayam paccayo yena tam avyākatam Bhagavatā
